verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a web-based SaaS platform, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, analytics or cookie controls, or any opt-out setting. The pack covers only visa services, case tracking, secure document storage and renewal reminders, none of which concern usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
